events.title: Snake Boss Reptile Show
events.description: Snake Boss Reptile Show at Kings Beach TavernGet ready for a wild school holiday experience at Kings Beach Tavern.Snake Boss is bringing an exciting reptile show to the venue on Thursday 24 September from 11.00am. Get up close to some amazing reptiles and learn more about these fascinating creatures in an entertaining experience for the whole family.Bring the kids along, enjoy a family lunch and make a day of it at Kings Beach Tavern.Thursday 24 SeptemberShow starts at 11.00amBookings are recommended.

events.description: Spider-Man and Elsa Are Visiting Kings Beach TavernMake the school holidays extra special with a visit from two favourite characters at Kings Beach Tavern.Bring the kids along for lunch and say hello to Spider-Man on Tuesday 22 September or Elsa on Tuesday 29 September.Spider-ManTuesday 22 September | 12.00pm–2.00pmElsaTuesday 29 September | 12.00pm–2.00pmEnjoy a family lunch, take some photos and make magical school holiday memories together.Bookings are recommended.
